rules.title: AV Tools: Devices Not Networked (Absent from Prometheus)

model.rawSql:
-- Per-device: active EAM devices absent from Prometheus (not networked)
-- Returns: one row per device -> equipmentno (label) + value=1 (fires per device)
--
-- Join key: equipmentno (EAM primary key == landb_ipaddresses primary key).
--   The avtools Prometheus exporter labels every series with `equipmentno`;
--   serial number is NOT a Prometheus label, so EAM<->telemetry joins on equipmentno.
-- "Not networked" == no landb_ipaddresses row: avtools only pings devices that have
--   a LanDB IP, so a device with no IP is never pinged and never appears in Prometheus.

WITH
active_devices AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.assetstatus_display::varchar), ''), '__MISSING__')
        NOT IN ('Withdrawn', 'Hors service définitif')
)
SELECT
  d.equipmentno AS equipmentno,
  1::bigint     AS value
FROM active_devices d
LEFT JOIN landb_ipaddresses l
  ON l.equipmentno = d.equipmentno
WHERE l.equipmentno IS NULL;

annotations.description:
- Devices not networked (per-device)
  Fires once per active EAM device that has no LanDB IP registration (joined on equipmentno).
  These devices are never pinged and never appear in the Prometheus ping/snmp series, so they cannot be monitored.
  Action: register the device in LanDB (assign an IP/hostname) so it can be reached and monitored.
annotations.summary: EAM device {{ $labels.equipmentno }} is in inventory but not networked
